# Kunemi UI

> Kunemi UI is an accessible, extensible, and AI-native React design system built on Base UI primitives, styled with Tailwind CSS v4 and semantic CSS variables, and distributed via a shadcn-compatible registry.

## Core Rules for AI Coding Agents
- Never bypass Base UI primitives for stable interactive widgets (dialog, select, tooltip, etc.).
- Never hardcode colors or hex values. Always use semantic CSS variable classes (`bg-[var(--background)]`, `text-[var(--foreground)]`, `border-[var(--border)]`, etc.).
- Isolation: Never import `@kunemi-ui/behaviors` inside `@kunemi-ui/ui`.
- All interactive components must support keyboard interaction, visible focus rings, ARIA roles/states, and WCAG 2.2 AA contrast compliance.

## Registry & Installation
Kunemi UI components can be installed into consumer projects using the shadcn CLI:

```bash
# Add components via registry URL
npx shadcn@latest add https://kunemi-ui.dev/r/button.json
npx shadcn@latest add https://kunemi-ui.dev/r/dialog.json
npx shadcn@latest add https://kunemi-ui.dev/r/prompt-input.json
```

Registry Manifest Index: https://kunemi-ui.dev/r/index.json

## Available Components
- `button`: Primary, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive variants with size support.
- `input`: Accessible text input with focus rings and error states.
- `label`: Accessible label with optional required indicator.
- `checkbox`: Accessible checkbox backed by Base UI Checkbox primitive.
- `switch`: Accessible switch toggle backed by Base UI Switch primitive.
- `dialog`: Modal dialog with overlay, portal, title, description, and close mechanics.
- `select`: Dropdown select with portal, popup, items, and roving focus.
- `tooltip`: Accessible floating tooltip with customizable placement and delays.
- `tabs`: Accessible tabbed navigation with list, trigger, and content panels.
- `badge`: Status and categorization badge with semantic variant styling.
- `card`: Surface container with header, title, description, content, and footer.
- `alert`: Accessible banner alert for informational, warning, and error messages.
- `skeleton`: Loading state placeholder with pulse animation.
- `separator`: Semantic horizontal and vertical dividers.
- `table`: Full HTML table suite (Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell, TableCaption).
- `pagination`: Full pagination controls (Pagination, PaginationContent, PaginationItem, PaginationLink, PaginationPrevious, PaginationNext, PaginationEllipsis).
- `toast`: Zero-dependency notification toast with title, description, and action.
- `menu`: Context and dropdown menu suite with items, triggers, and separators.

## AI-Native Building Blocks
- `prompt-input`: Expandable AI prompt composer with keyboard submission (Enter to submit, Shift+Enter for newline) and submit/cancel controls.
- `tool-status`: Tool execution lifecycle badge and collapsible details (`queued`, `running`, `succeeded`, `failed`, `cancelled`).
- `approval-dialog`: Consequential action confirmation modal with danger level indicator and explicit affirmative confirmation.

## Composed Blocks
- `AuthCard`: Complete sign-in / registration card pattern with email and password inputs.
- `MetricCard`: KPI / Analytics dashboard metric block with value, delta, and subtitle.
- `AIChatBlock`: AI chat view combining prompt composer, streamed responses, and agent tool execution status.

## Verification Commands
Before concluding turns when working on Kunemi UI:
- `pnpm typecheck`
- `pnpm lint`
- `pnpm test`
